name: pg_pinecone
desc: Self-hosted extension that adds vector search to a Postgres database.
desc_zh: 给 Postgres 数据库加上向量搜索能力的开源扩展。
solves: Vector data living in a separate service means joins and backups get hard; the index sits inside the database you already run.
solves_zh: 向量数据放在另一个服务里，关联查询和备份都变难；索引就放在你已经在跑的数据库里。
best_for: Your data is already in Postgres and you want similarity search without a second system.
best_for_zh: 数据本来就在 Postgres 里，想要相似度搜索又不想再上一套系统。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — pinecone.io/blog）。 Blog post byline Harshita Daddala, Anthony Mahanna, Oct 27, 2026. An open-source product distinct from the managed Pinecone service the ledger holds; the blog index also shows a Nov 18, 2026 post about one-click Railway deployment. 首次公开日期来源：https://www.pinecone.io/blog/introducing-pg-pinecone/
